breaking: Passwords are now limited to 64 characters instead of 256 in login and password settings; existing passwords longer than 64 characters are no longer accepted at login.
features: Rename work sessions from their context menu.
Preview Markdown files with rendered formatting or switch to source view in session file views and standalone viewers, with preview scroll positions preserved.
Check for and install Pi updates from the desktop control center, with cancellation and automatic pausing and recovery of running local services after installation validation.
Open local and remote Pi Desk instances in the system browser from the desktop control center; local services start before the browser opens.
Preview affected projects and their old and new default model settings before saving model replacements, then apply replacements to project defaults.

Enable optional automatic image cleanup in the context plugin to omit older images from model requests when configured limits are exceeded and block oversized new image batches with a warning. This setting is off by default.
added: Plugin session-sidebar tabs can provide header actions; the Deliverables tab now includes a refresh action.
changed: Batch plugin installation and updates now prepare and validate candidates in parallel before applying them sequentially.
fixed: Plugin reinstallation preserves existing package configuration and can repair an installation whose target files are missing after a failed reinstall.
Long-pressing a session to open its context menu no longer selects it on touch release; keyboard context-menu shortcuts are also supported.
removed: Removed the power-saving appearance setting and animated session-status borders.
